fix(lanes): a pane's session is read from its Claude Code's record at the asking, and a request not known to run in a pane releases nothing (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.1dh.aom)

High review of #663:
- The takeover check and the pane-session reply read the record when they ask, so a stamp from before a /clear no longer answers for the pane.
- A request whose parent is not the pane's Claude Code is no evidence about where its session runs: a held session stays where it is.
- A record that fails to parse is read once more: Claude Code rewrites it in place.
- One record reader: the lane edge is handed the daemon's.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

fix(lanes): a pane's status line and bar pane follow the session its Claude Code holds, not any client run in the pane (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.1dh.aom)

Every process in a tmux pane inherits TMUX and TMUX_PANE, so a one-shot
`cc-candybar` run from Claude Code's Bash tool, under any session id, became
"the pane's session": the status line released the pane to it and a bar pane
followed it.

The client now reports its parent pid (for a statusline, Claude Code itself,
measured on 2.1.299). The render checkpoint reads that process's own record,
`<config dir>/sessions/<pid>.json`, the one the restart already reads, and
stamps the request with the pane its session runs in: outside, runs, or
unconfirmed with why. The status line's holds and the pane-session reply read
only that stamp, so namesPane is gone. Every render event records it as
`pane=`, and while the status line or a bar pane is on, an unconfirmed session's
bar carries a ⚠ that says why.

fix(click): a click is read once at the daemon's edge, and its event carries that read (brandon-menus-sjhy.ovq)

The edge read a click to find its session, then the verb's run read the raw
value again, and the journal, the landing stamp and the fold took their
session from that second read. Now `readClick` reads a link once, at the
edge, into a branded Click whose dispatch session is taken from its effects
in the read. The click event carries that Click, and `runClick` runs from it,
so the session the reply facts record, the one the journal and landing use,
and the steps the fold performs are one value.

The click table holds what a link can name: dispatch, and the doctor's
probe, whose nonce is now parsed at the edge too. A link naming a leaf verb
itself, which nothing draws, is an unknown click verb refused at the edge.
foldEffects is the one leaf runner. VERBS, VERB_NAMES, ClickVerb, clickVerb,
clickSessionOf and decodeWire are gone, and the drawn-link reader refuses a
link that names anything but dispatch.

Tests click as the bar does. The helpers that split a drawn link and ran
each effect as its own click (one turn and undo step per effect, no
batching) run the whole link, and hand-built single-verb clicks go through
a one-effect dispatch link (test/helpers/click.ts clickEffect, effectLink).

fix(recording): a click's state crosses the recording ahead of the document it keyed (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.6pj.09q) (#662)

* fix(recording): a click's state crosses the recording ahead of the document it keyed, so a replay keeps the old run's value until the new one lands (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.6pj.09q)

A recording now writes a state line whenever the session's clicks' state moved
before a document; the replay restores it there instead of only at the next
draw. RECORDING_VERSION 6 -> 7.

Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>

## [1.208.4](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-candybar/compare/v1.208.3...v1.208.4) (2026-11-07)

### Bug Fixes

* **testing:** every budgeted wait in a test is cut to what its case has left, so a slow run fails by the wait's name (brandon-menus-sjhy.r62) ([#661](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-candybar/issues/661)) ([71d231b](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-candybar/commit/71d231b7b17cb286ba143c6b7c09d3046d2af023))

feat(band): a switched-off band lane holds no follower process (candybar-animation-wbxz.w33)

The band mod stops its follow child on the daemon's SWITCHED_OFF answer
instead of keeping it alive to re-ask every 5s, and turning band (A) off
uninstalls the mod so sessions started afterwards never load it. An
uninstall of a mod that is not installed is the state off asks for, so it
is said rather than thrown.
